real_run_capability_disclosure.proven_in_preparation: The V4 authority chain is fully WIRED and FAIL-CLOSED, verified with ZERO provider/builder/checker invocation: signed activation -> governed public-key authority -> VERIFIED capability -> governed one-time consumption -> signed launch intent -> ONE-USE inherited-descriptor ephemeral-key transfer -> detached supervisor that INDEPENDENTLY re-verifies -> signed supervisor claim -> SUPERVISOR_EXECUTION capability -> provider eligibility -> spawn boundary. A complete bounded execution + teardown is proven end to end against a DETERMINISTIC stub provider through the real production CLI. V3/V2 records are refused at every new production entrypoint.
real_run_capability_disclosure.NOT_proven_in_preparation: Actual productive work (a real builder session producing changes, and a real checker session returning CLEAN) is NOT exercised or proven here, because that requires invoking the real provider (Claude), which is forbidden during preparation. The FIRST place real productive capability is exercised is the founder-signed run itself.
real_run_capability_disclosure.founder_must_accept: Enrolling a founder key and signing authorizes the first internal run to invoke the real provider through this wired, fail-closed machinery. Whether jobs actually COMPLETE depends on real builder + checker behavior, first observed under signature.
